title: Add KitKind Enum to C# Net Library
description: Add KitKind enum with five values (File, Folder, Archive, Remote, Temporary) to Semio.cs with lowercase JSON serialization and xUnit tests
summary: Added KitKind enum with 5 values (File, Folder, Archive, Remote, Temporary) to Semio.cs using JsonConverter(StringEnumConverter) and EnumMember for lowercase JSON serialization. Added KitKinds static helper class. Added 13 xUnit tests (enum count, serialize, deserialize, roundtrip, AllKitKinds). All tests pass.
